description.en: Offers the player a save: it records the save point (CMND_SET_SAVE_INFO(_phase_no, _map_id, _pos), only if that command exists), blacks out both screens, opens the save menu (CMND_MAKE_CHILD_MENU_SCENE("SaveMenu", 0, caution, 2)) and waits until it closes, then brings the screens back.
Phase number stored with the save.
Map where the game resumes, e.g. "mr01b06".
Passed to the save menu as 1 or 0 (the developers' spelling of caution).

examples.case: A save point at the end of a chapter (real usage, from ev42015100.nut)
